Secret files — never commit *.env .env .env.* secrets.env k8s/overlays/local/secrets.env scripts/bootstrap-secrets.sh.local ``` 驗證： ```bash grep -E '\.env|secrets\.env' .gitignore && echo "OK: .gitignore covers secrets" || echo "ERROR: .gitignore missing secret patterns" git check-ignore -v k8s/overlays/local/secrets.env # Expected: 顯示 .gitignore 規則命中 ``` ### 三層 Secret 策略 | 層 | 類型 | 適用密碼 | 管理方式 | |----|------|---------|---------| | **層 1** | Ephemeral（每次重生成）| `DB_PASSWORD`、`HMAC_SECRET`（v2 預留）、`PGADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD`、`DATA_PROTECTION_KEY` | 每次 `make k8s-init` 或 `make secrets-rotate` 重生成（openssl rand）| | **層 2** | OS Keychain（固定憑證）| `GHCR_TOKEN`（image push）、`NUGET_API_KEY` | macOS Keychain / Windows Credential Manager | | **層 3** | Enterprise Password Manager（可選）| `JAEGER_AUTH_TOKEN`（若啟用 Jaeger UI auth）| 1Password `op inject` / Bitwarden Secrets Manager | --- ### 層 1：Ephemeral 密碼 Bootstrap（必做） 每次重啟 cluster 或執行 `make k8s-clean` 後，執行以下 bootstrap script 重新生成所有密碼。 **macOS / Linux — `scripts/bootstrap-secrets.sh`：** ```bash #!/usr/bin/env bash # scripts/bootstrap-secrets.sh # Auto-generate ephemeral K8s secrets — never commit this output set -euo pipefail NAMESPACE="${NAMESPACE:-erp-token-local}" PROJECT_SLUG="erp-token" echo "[bootstrap-secrets] Generating ephemeral secrets for namespace: ${NAMESPACE}" # Ensure namespace exists kubectl create namespace "${NAMESPACE}" --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f - # Delete existing secrets to force regeneration kubectl delete secret "${PROJECT_SLUG}-api-secret" -n "${NAMESPACE}" --ignore-not-found kubectl delete secret "${PROJECT_SLUG}-db-secret" -n "${NAMESPACE}" --ignore-not-found kubectl delete secret "${PROJECT_SLUG}-pgadmin-secret" -n "${NAMESPACE}" --ignore-not-found # Generate ephemeral values DB_PASSWORD="$(openssl rand -hex 32)" HMAC_SECRET="$(openssl rand -hex 64)" DATA_PROTECTION_KEY="$(openssl rand -hex 32)" PGADMIN_PASSWORD="$(openssl rand -base64 16 | tr -dc 'a-zA-Z0-9' | head -c 16)" # api-server connection string (Npgsql format) CONNECTION_STRING="Host=postgres;Port=5432;Database=erpapikey;Username=erpapp;Password=${DB_PASSWORD}" # api-server Secret kubectl create secret generic "${PROJECT_SLUG}-api-secret" \ -n "${NAMESPACE}" \ --from-literal=ConnectionStrings__ApiTokenDb="${CONNECTION_STRING}" \ --from-literal=HmacSecret="${HMAC_SECRET}" \ --from-literal=DataProtection__Key="${DATA_PROTECTION_KEY}" # postgres bootstrap Secret kubectl create secret generic "${PROJECT_SLUG}-db-secret" \ -n "${NAMESPACE}" \ --from-literal=POSTGRES_DB="erpapikey" \ --from-literal=POSTGRES_USER="erpapp" \ --from-literal=POSTGRES_PASSWORD="${DB_PASSWORD}" # pgadmin Secret kubectl create secret generic "${PROJECT_SLUG}-pgadmin-secret" \ -n "${NAMESPACE}" \ --from-literal=PGADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL="admin@erp-token.local" \ --from-literal=PGADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD="${PGADMIN_PASSWORD}" echo "[bootstrap-secrets] OK: Ephemeral secrets created in ${NAMESPACE}" echo "[bootstrap-secrets] Secrets are ephemeral — regenerated on every cluster restart" echo "[bootstrap-secrets] pgadmin login: admin@erp-token.local / ${PGADMIN_PASSWORD}" ``` ```bash # 每次 cluster 啟動時執行 chmod +x scripts/bootstrap-secrets.sh ./scripts/bootstrap-secrets.sh # 或透過 make target（§6 Development Commands 已提供） make secrets-rotate ``` **Windows — `scripts/bootstrap-secrets.ps1`：** ```powershell # 儲存憑證到 macOS Keychain（首次設定） security add-generic-password \ -s "erp-token-ghcr" \ -a "dev" \ -w "" # 讀取憑證並登入（CI dry-run 或本機 push） GHCR_TOKEN=$(security find-generic-password -w -s "erp-token-ghcr" -a "dev") echo "${GHCR_TOKEN}" | nerdctl login ghcr.io --username erp-org-bot --password-stdin ``` **Windows Credential Manager（PowerShell）：** ```powershell Install-Module -Name CredentialManager -Force New-StoredCredential -Target "erp-token-ghcr" -UserName "erp-org-bot" -Password "" $cred = Get-StoredCredential -Target "erp-token-ghcr" $token = $cred.GetNetworkCredential().Password echo $token | nerdctl login ghcr.io --username erp-org-bot --password-stdin ``` --- ### 層 3：mittwald/kubernetes-secret-generator（進階選項） 如果偏好 **in-cluster 全自動生成**（無需手動執行 bootstrap script）： ```bash helm repo add mittwald https://helm.mittwald.de helm upgrade --install secret-generator mittwald/kubernetes-secret-generator \ -n kube-system ``` ```yaml # k8s/overlays/local/secrets.yaml — 範例（可選方案） apiVersion: v1 kind: Secret metadata: name: erp-token-api-secret namespace: erp-token-local annotations: secret-generator.v1.mittwald.de/autogenerate: "HmacSecret,DataProtection__Key" secret-generator.v1.mittwald.de/length: "64" secret-generator.v1.mittwald.de/type: "string" type: Opaque ``` > **何時用 mittwald**：當不需要在 bootstrap script 中讀取明文密碼（app 直接從 K8s Secret 讀取）時較便利。但 `ConnectionStrings__ApiTokenDb` 與 `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` 必須兩處同值，仍建議走層 1 openssl rand 流程。 --- ### 驗證 Secret 已正確建立 ```bash # 確認 secret 存在（不顯示值） kubectl get secret -n erp-token-local # 確認所有 key 都存在 kubectl get secret erp-token-api-secret -n erp-token-local \ -o jsonpath='{.data}' | python3 -c " import sys, json keys = list(json.load(sys.stdin).keys()) required = ['ConnectionStrings__ApiTokenDb', 'HmacSecret', 'DataProtection__Key'] missing = [k for k in required if k not in keys] print('Missing:', missing) if missing else print('OK: All required api secrets present') " # 確認 .gitignore 涵蓋 secret 檔案 grep -E '\.env|secrets\.env' .gitignore && echo "OK: .gitignore" || echo "ERROR: .gitignore missing secret patterns" ``` --- ## 4. Step-by-Step Setup ### 4.1 Clone & Configure ```bash git clone git@github.com:erp-org/erp-api-token-manager.git cd erp-api-token-manager # 確認 branch git status # Expected: On branch main / develop ``` ### 4.2 Rancher Desktop 設定 ```bash # 1. 確認 k3s context 已注入 kubectl config get-contexts # 應看到 rancher-desktop 並標示 *（current） # 若未自動設定： kubectl config use-context rancher-desktop # 2. 確認 K8s API server 可連線 kubectl cluster-info # Expected: Kubernetes control plane is running at https://127.0.0.1:6443 # 驗證 /etc/hosts 設定生效 getent hosts erp-token.local || dscacheutil -q host -a name erp-token.local # Expected (macOS): 127.0.0.1 erp-token.local ``` ### 4.3 建立 K8s Secret Secret 不走 ConfigMap，不提交到 git。Local 環境全為開發隨機值，由 `scripts/bootstrap-secrets.sh` 自動生成，**無需人工填寫**： ```bash #
